envelope.description: Publish the steering text safely and document the rollout

body.title: Publish the steering text safely and document the rollout
body.summary: Gate publication of the request guidance so the daemon's boot-time steering refresh includes it only when the daemon advertises analyze-request; update src/prompts/steering-block.md (the injected skeleton), src/mcp/steering-template.md and the tool descriptions to tell agents to send the request object while keeping the search-versus-analysis rule; document the deploy order (update MCP processes, then restart the daemon, or suspend analysis during the transition), that in-flight tokens end at the restart, that zeroDowntime is false, that prompt-only calls stay accepted with refusal only by a declared contract in a later Story, and that the follow-up Story is limited to runners that already have an area filter.
acceptanceChecks: the boot refresh does not publish the request guidance when the capability is absent
the injected skeleton from steering-block.md tells agents to send the request object and keeps the decision rule
the migration notes state zeroDowntime false and the deploy order

tests.name: steering-analyze-request.test.ts: the injected skeleton from steering-block.md, the template and both tool descriptions tell agents to send the request object and keep the decision rule
steering-gated-refresh.test.ts: the boot refresh does not publish the request guidance when the capability is absent and publishes it when present
